_comment: Per-run metrics snapshots. Two kinds of payload share this index, distinguished by the `kind` discriminator: (1) percentile-distribution snapshots for threshold migrations (brutal-review phase 4) populate p50..p99 + n; (2) aggregate-list snapshots populate the nested `items` array. Strict-dynamic: new metric kinds use the `kind` discriminator and one of the two existing payload shapes; new payload shapes require a mapping migration first.
